6.description: [Molten Core] [Ragnaros] Ragnaros now correctly drops Tier 2 Paladin, Rogue, Shaman Legs instead of Belts on heroic and ascended difficulty. Player that obtained a belt can exchange them for leg token at Major Mattingly and Overlord Runthak.
[Molten Core] [Ragnaros] Corrected an issue where Ragnaros would not knock players away upon emerge.
[Molten Core] [Ragnaros] Corrected an issue where Ragnaros unintentionally multiplied all of his events whenever he emerges. He still adds Lava Bursts to his events on every emerge.
[Molten Core] [Baron Geddon] Corrected an issue where Baron Geddon would keep his Inferno buff longer then intended.
[Molten Core] [Baron Geddon] Corrected an issue where Living Bombs would not explode.
[ZulGurub] Removed all restrictions to the usage of World Buffs inside ZulGurub with the release of Molten Core.
[Molten Core] [Ragnaros] Corrected an issue where Majordomo Executus and Ragnaros would end every sentence with a question mark during their introduction conversation.
[Molten Core] [Ragnaros] Ragnaros now exclusively drops Tier 2 Leg Token.
[Molten Core] [Ragnaros] Ragnaros will now properly evade if their are no player left a life during his submerged phase.

[Molten Core] [Ragnaros] Hand of Ragnaros is now a cone shaped ability with 40 yard range instead of a chained target ability only hitting player in melee range. He now casts at a random target within 40 yards instead of a target in melee range.
[Molten Core] [Ragnaros] Ragnaros will no longer cast Wrath of Ragnaros.
[Molten Core] [Ragnaros] Ragnaros has been partially reworked.
[Molten Core] [Majordomo Executus] The Cache of the Firelord will now award correct currency to player.
[Molten Core] [Majordomo Executus] Corrected an issue where Majordomo would sometimes fail to recognize that he has lost the battle and not teleport to Ragnaros Lair.
[Molten Core] [Majordomo Executus] Flamewaker Elite and Flamewaker Healer are now both eligible targets for all forms of crowd control except Charm, Knockback, Banish, Fear and Horrified.
[Molten Core] [Sulfuron Harbinger] Sulfuron Harbinger now exclusively drops Tier 1 Feet Token.
[Molten Core] [Golemagg the Incinerator] Golemagg now exclusively drops Tier 1 Chest Token.
[Molten Core] [Shazzrah] Shazzrah now exclusively drops Tier 1 Hand Token.
[Molten Core] [Shazzrah] Increased the time until Shazzrah reaches Berserk to 10 minutes up from 5 minutes.

[Molten Core] [Shazzrah] Magic Grounding, now called Dampen Magic, in addition of being removed on dispel now also has charges, causing Dampen Magic to be removed if all charges are depleted. Charges can be removed from Melee and Ranged special attacks and abilities.
[Molten Core] [Shazzrah] Shazzrah will now teleport himself and all player to his spawn location whenever executing the Ultimate Arcane Explosion.

[Molten Core] [Shazzrah] Corrected an issue where the target of Arcane Instability, now called Arcane Bomb, would become the owner of Arcane Instability, causing it to scale with the effected players damage increasing and reducing effects.
[Molten Core] [Shazzrah] Shazzrah no longer teleports to random player locations and no longer resets his threat.
[Molten Core] [Shazzrah] Shazzrah has been partially reworked.
[Molten Core] [Baron Geddon] Baron Geddon now exclusively drops Tier 1 Shoulder Token.
[Molten Core] [Baron Geddon] Baron Geddon no longer kills himself by casting Armageddon at low health, instead he will now start to cast Inferno and no longer stop until he or all player died.
[Molten Core] [Baron Geddon] Inferno now hits all targets regardless of distance. Inferno damage will no longer increase multiplicative during its channel and instead now increases linearly.

[Molten Core] [Baron Geddon] Corrected an issue where the target of Living Bomb would become the owner of Living Bomb, causing it to scale with the effected players damage increasing and reducing effects.
[Molten Core] [Baron Geddon] Baron Geddon has been partially reworked.
[Molten Core] [Garr] Garr now exclusively drops Tier 1 Head Token.
[Molten Core] [Garr] Garr will no longer remove magic effects from players, instead he now periodically silences all player.
[Molten Core] [Garr] Garr has been partially reworked.
[Molten Core] [Gehennas] Gehennas now exclusively drops Tier 1 Waist Token.
[Molten Core] [Lucifron] Lucifron now exclusively drops Tier 1 Wrist Token.
[Molten Core] [Magmadar] Magmadar now exclusively drops Tier 1 Leg Token.
[Molten Core] [Magmadar] Magmadar has been fully reworked. He now has new mechanics and ascended mechanics.
[Molten Core] Finkle Einhorn, the famous adventurer has been reported missing AGAIN. Ironforge authorities report he has been last seen near Blackrock Mountain.

[Molten Core] The Bindings of the Windseeker no longer start a quest in their normal version, instead they combine directly into the Vessel of Rebirth, jumping over the previously first step of the questline.
[Molten Core] All items, including legendary items now exist in Heroic and Ascended versions.
[Molten Core] All bosses inside Molten Core are now able to drop Sulfuron Ingot.
[Molten Core] Tier 1 and Tier 2 Set Token can be exchanged at Major Mattingly in Stormwind and Overlord Runthak in Orgrimmar.
[Molten Core] All bosses and trash creatures no longer drop Tier 1 Set Items directly, instead all bosses up to Majordomo  now drop Tier 1, for Ragnaros Tier 2, Set Token.

[Molten Core] The loot of Magmadar, Lucifron, Gehennas, Garr, Baron Geddon, Shazzrah, Golemagg and Sulfuron Harbinger has been redistributed evenly among said bosses. This causes items that were previously shared between all bosses to drop less often and causes items that were exclusive to a single boss to drop more often.

[Molten Core] All bosses have been updated to latest standards including proper despawn on evade, sending of the boss frame to player clients, ignoring of invisibility and feign death effects, no longer following the parry hasten rules, no longer reposition in combat.
[Molten Core] All trash creatures now use updated spells and abilities, old improved versions and completely new.
[Molten Core] Pending Restart - Molten Core has been partially reworked.
